channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 57 new entries
item.description:
57 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, proteomics, histology / imaging-only, multi-omics, and 3 more.

Sphinx
R package for adaptive spatial neighborhood modeling, cell annotation, and functional analysis in spatial proteomics.

SigDoTS
Hierarchical hypothesis-testing framework to decide merging/retention of candidate spatial domains.

Benchmarking cell segmentation in two Spatialomics platforms with open-source software
Benchmarks fourteen cell segmentation algorithms against pathologist ground truth on spatial proteomics images.

spaDWGCN
Distance-weighted graph convolutional network jointly modeling expression and neighborhood composition for spatial domains.

SPIN
Integrates subject-specific spatial co-expression networks with Bayesian scalar-on-network regression for clinical prediction.

MorphoANOVA
Gene-wise spatially varying coefficient model and ANOVA to dissect morphology-expression associations in spatial transcriptomics.

THiRST
Registers and integrates serial 2D spatial transcriptomics sections into multi-resolution 3D tissue representations.

GESSO
Estimates spatial gene set activity scores with gene-level contributions and location-specific statistical tests.

ASAOT
Asymmetric optimal transport framework with sharpening regularization for spatial deconvolution and single-cell mapping.

PRISM
Expectation-maximization framework assigning cell-type identity while correcting ambient RNA contamination and segmentation doublets.

GeneSPOT
Optimal transport framework characterizing and comparing spatial relationships among genes across conditions and time.

CroSP
Multi-view graph autoencoder integrating expression, location and morphology for spatial domain identification.

LingoCell
Foundation model aligning single-cell and spatial transcriptomic representations with language for annotation and perturbation analysis.

PIANO
Generative autoencoder framework integrating single-cell and spatial transcriptomics across species and scales to 100M cells.

spSheaf
Sheaf-theoretic method infers spatial domains directly from raw molecules without cell segmentation.

SpaCoDA
Fast compositional deconvolution method identifies and integrates recurrent cellular niches across hundreds of spatial sections.

MacSGP
Graph neural network and probabilistic framework identifies cell-type-specific spatial gene expression programs defining tissue niches.

Hist2Prot
Deep learning model that predicts single-cell spatial proteomic profiles from routine H&E histology images.

CONCLAVE
Consensus-clustering workflow combining multiple algorithms to produce robust cell annotations from cyclic multiplexed immunofluorescence data.

msiFlow 2.0
Extended open-source workflow adding mass recalibration, lipid annotation, batch correction and QC to MSI data processing.

REZCUE
Antigen retrieval chemistry enabling 3D multiplexed imaging and multi-omic profiling of archived FFPE tissue.

BCR-MERFISH
Measures plasma cell clonality and V gene usage alongside transcriptome profiling in situ.

Protocol for integrated multimodal spatial RNA and protein profiling using Xenium and MACSima
Protocol and scripts for combined spatial RNA (Xenium) and cyclic protein (MACSima) imaging on same section.

MuSpec
Multi-scale attention-fusion encoder that learns spatial niche embeddings from spatial transcriptomics data.

Perturb-Tags
Spatially barcoded pooled CRISPR screening measuring expression, guides, chromatin accessibility, and position jointly.

scPolyA
AI framework quantifying alternative polyadenylation in single-cell/spatial transcriptomes via deep learning and NL agent.

gsMap
Integrates GWAS summary statistics with spatial transcriptomics via GNN embeddings to map trait-associated cells.

scVIVA-Tools
Unified software toolkit for analyzing spatial transcriptomics data.

bento-tools
Python toolkit for subcellular spatial analysis of spatial transcriptomics data.

A Cooperative Matrix for Enhanced MALDI MSI of Metabolic Alterations Associated with Oxidative Stress in Spinal Cord Injury
Dual-component co-matrix for MALDI MSI enabling broad-spectrum imaging of oxidative-stress-related metabolites.

A Streamlined Approach for Spatial Matrisomics with High-Confidence Annotation of Extracellular Protein Alterations in Functional Tissue Units
Parallel FFPE MALDI-MSI/LC-MS workflow with an open-source mass-matching pipeline for spatial ECM peptide annotation.

SpaMEDM
Masked autoencoder with diffusion-based latent regularization for spatial multi-omics domain identification.

spOT-NMF
Optimal-transport-based NMF deconvolves mixed spatial transcriptomic signals and maps spatial niches without matched references.

IsoPrism
Structure-guided iterative allocation framework predicting isoform usage from short-read single-cell/spatial transcriptomes.

TRACER
Twin-contrastive graph autoencoder identifies fine-grained and rare spatial domains in transcriptomics data.

SpatioCAD
Graph diffusion model that detects spatially variable genes while correcting for cell-density confounding.

SWIMR
Statistical framework integrating multiple scRNA-seq references with spatial correlations for cell-type deconvolution.

Atera
Independent evaluation comparing Atera whole-transcriptome spatial platform against Xenium in DCIS tissue.

spAlignDE
Diffeomorphic registration framework aligning spatial data across samples and modalities with mismatch-aware differential expression.

SubPoE
Subgraph-induced Product-of-Experts graph model fusing spatial multi-omics modalities via uncertainty-aware encoders.

ARCADE
Framework building robust references and decoupling cell-type abundance from continuous transcriptional state in spatial data.

TileScope
Framework combining regional enrichment, correlation and boundary statistics to analyze spatial gene expression organization.

InSpace
Framework mapping transcripts to radial coordinates and measuring distance-dependent molecular co-occurrence within cells.

SpaceBlocks
Snakemake workflow homogenizing multi-platform spatial transcriptomics data for expert-supervised cohort analysis.

OncoSpot
Cancer-aware simulator generating ground-truth spot-based ST data to benchmark copy-number and subclone inference methods.

QUEST
Predicts multiplex immunofluorescence protein expression images from routine H&E histology using query-based model.

PixAQ
Probabilistic marker-specific pixel attribution improving single-cell protein quantification from imaging mass cytometry.

Tracel
Two-stage optimal transport framework reassigning transcripts/bins to cells using a scRNA-seq reference.

CytoBridge
Reconstructs continuous cell trajectories and interactions from discrete spatial transcriptomics via Schrödinger bridge modeling.

DisCell
Generative latent-variable model separating intrinsic state, niche response, and spillover in single-cell spatial data.

SSAF-T
Agentic, segmentation-free framework using LLM agents to infer cell types directly from spatial expression.

scCircaSim
Simulates circadian single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data with known phase ground truth for method evaluation.

SPACE-Tag
Converts chromatin-bound DNA marks into RNA for spatial CUT&Tag profiling via standard transcriptomic workflows.

STARgrid
Open-source pipeline processing Visium HD sequencing reads into spatial gene expression count matrices.

NicheDE
Detects context-dependent (niche-associated) gene expression changes in spatial transcriptomics data.

EnrichMap
Performs spatially-informed gene set enrichment analysis for functional interpretation of spatial transcriptomics data.

STAIG
Image-aided graph contrastive learning for clustering and alignment-free integration of spatial transcriptomics datasets.
